question: In the following question, four words are given out of which one word is incorrectly spelt. Select the incorrectly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e., "**Begining**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Begining"** is spelt incorrectly.
 
• The correct spelling is **"Beginning"**. It means the point in time or space at which something starts. (शुरुआत)
 
 
• **Example: **The **beginning **of the movie was very captivating.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word "**Begining**" is incorrectly spelt, and the correct spelling is "**Beginning**".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Annually** (वार्षिक): Occurring once every year.

 
 
• **Example:** The company holds an **annual **meeting with its employees.
 
 
 
• **Atheist** (नास्तिक): A person who does not believe in the existence of God or gods.
 
 
• **Example:** He identifies as an **atheist **and does not follow any religion.
